scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB,WORKER "npm run dev --workspace @familyhub/api" "npm run dev --workspace @familyhub/web" "npm run dev:worker --workspace @familyhub/api"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @familyhub/api && npm run build --workspace @familyhub/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @familyhub/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @familyhub/web
scripts.format: prettier --write apps/api/src apps/api/prisma apps/web/src docs scripts/*.mjs eslint.config.mjs .github/workflows/ci.yml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps/api/src apps/api/prisma apps/web/src docs scripts/*.mjs eslint.config.mjs .github/workflows/ci.yml
